title: Correct launch current
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be I = 80 A.

title: Correct coil resistance
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be R = 0.5 Ω.

title: Correct retraction time
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (3) must be t3 = (√5 + 3)/2 s or approximately 2.62 s.

title: Newton's law for launch
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the launch phase (0 to t1) to relate the Ampere force to the total mass and acceleration.

title: Force analysis for retraction
description: Important: The solution must set up the equation of motion for the retraction phase (t1 to t3), combining the applied force F, the magnetic damping force, and the deceleration.

title: Charge-momentum relationship
description: Important: The solution must derive and apply the impulse-momentum theorem (or equivalent) relating the total charge flown during retraction to the change in momentum via the magnetic impulse.

title: Kinematic consistency
description: Optional: The solution correctly uses the v-t graph information to find displacements, times (like t2), and the constant deceleration magnitude.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for sign errors in the magnetic force direction during retraction or in the impulse-momentum equation.

title: Algebraic or unit mistake
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for incorrect algebraic manipulation of the simultaneous equations or for inconsistent/omitted units in intermediate steps.
